notes.title: "Trigger Time" full source code release!
notes.content:
We are glad to announce that "Trigger Time" becomes open source! You can find complete source code for the game here: https://github.com/Sheph/TriggerTime

The game is released under BSD license so you're free to modify and create derivative works from it.
Enjoy!

notes.title: "Trigger Time" becomes free
notes.content:
[b]We are thrilled to announce that, from 15th of June you can play "Trigger Time" for free! [/b]
Enjoy the nine carefully crafted levels of classical shoot’em up.
To add more fun we will soon be releasing the game’s source code for any enthusiast to experiment with. 
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons & Backgrounds added!
notes.content:
Good News Everyone!

In addition to some minor bug-fixes and improvements we've released the first series of Steam Trading cards, badges, emoticons and backgrounds for you!

If you've been waiting, now is the time to buy this shoot 'em up gem that delivers a whole lot of action, gun play and puzzle driven gaming for a great value. It's the perfect summer bargain!
